rows.text: The key to piloting Lightning, Army of One is understanding its core engine: Lightning has first strike, trample, and lifelink. Her Stagger ability doubles all damage that player takes until your next turn. Combining her with extra combat steps and equipment turns each hit into lethal exponential damage.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Smothering Tithe, Teferi's Protection, Jeska's Will. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
